families.proposal: Keep an explicit no-effect component; do not invent damage for placeholders.
Physical HP damage; retain component targeting and hit weights. Random-hit and throw costs need their own parameter handling.
Magic HP damage with source element, targeting and hit timing; normalize power to FFR.
Magic damage, as requested. Convert the combined damage budget once; preserve elements, targets and hits. Review hybrid units' ATK/MAG allocation.
Piercing Force: normal physical/magic damage in a higher bounded power band. Do not silently set target DEF/SPR to zero; native DeffenceIgnore is enum-only.
Retain normal physical/magic damage and replace only the race bonus using the killer-theme table. Probe native DmgVariationByRace separately before rejecting it.
Retain physical/magic identity but normalize the power instead of claiming DEF/SPR/MP-based native scaling. Preserve all-MP costs where present; tank/healer scaling needs representative playtests.
Use the matching native current/max/caster HP formula only after decoding the opcode's basis and boss restrictions. Cap percentage attacks to prevent trivial boss kills.
Native Fixed calculation with FFR-scale values. Fixed and percentage damage must not inherit physical/magic multipliers accidentally.

Resolve the referenced skill and level-multiple condition separately. Native Level3Flare is a candidate only for the matching level-3 damage case; level-4 Gravity, level-5 Death or missing child IDs stay held until their conditions and immunities are supported.
Native Libra/Analyze on the decoded enemy target; preserve information-reveal behavior and avoid adding damage.

Decode fixed versus scaled periodic damage, element, duration and removability. Prototype a bounded native periodic damage action; if unsupported, propose Lingering Wound as Poison-style HP loss with the changed element/formula/immunity behavior disclosed. Charge the total ticks to one damage budget.
Restore HP/MP with the correct fixed or ratio basis, ally target and FFR power. Keep healing separate from enemy damage.
Regen/Refresh using native recovery events and bounded duration. Song channels become timed recovery unless their action lock can be reproduced.
Raise or Reraise according to source opcode; preserve dead-only targeting, restored HP and once-per-death behavior.
Split self-cost/sacrifice, damage and ally recovery. Costs remain costs; hold a branch for review when its resource or target cannot be preserved.
Damage plus HP/MP absorption with owner recovery and a capped ratio. Distinguish MP damage from MP recovered after HP damage.

Translate each stat separately. Permanent stats use mastery/base parameters; active buffs use tested native buffs or parameter changes. FFR Brave/Protect are not exact FFBE ATK/DEF percentages; cap stacks and duration.
ATK/DEF/MAG/SPR reductions become their native debuffs with conservative FFR magnitudes. Do not confuse FFBE stat breaks with FFR stagger damage.
Protect/Shell-style physical or magical damage reduction. Generic mitigation can combine both types under one shared cap; preserve exclusions.
Hunter's Ward: weaker general physical/magic mitigation of the same type. Broadening from one race must reduce strength.
Use the 12 race-themed substitutes in the review plan. Permanent and timed grants differ; share a power budget across multiple races. Native race-damage probe remains an alternative.
Map resist/weakness/immune states to native categories. Record lost percentages, caps, signs and stacking; never turn a debuff into protection.
Native elemental absorption where the selected resistance category is validated; otherwise downgrade explicitly to elemental immunity.
Elemental weapon enchantment with duration. Preserve existing attack elements; multi-element attacks need an explicit native combination or chosen-element rule.
Bounded native element-specific damage bonuses; do not convert an elemental buff into an unrestricted damage bonus.

Exact native status candidates include poison, blind, sleep, silence, paralysis, confusion, petrification, charm and stop. Decode status IDs and chance; Disease/Zombie use approved substitutes. Random application stays random.
Remove only the source ailment/debuff families from the correct side. A resistance or cure opcode must never apply the ailment.
Status resistance/immunity with decoded ailment set and duration. Stat-break resistance and instant-death immunity need separate native rows.
Sundered Will: modest MAG/SPR reduction if native ailment-resistance reduction cannot be validated. Retain the original resistance-loss description in conversion notes.
Select removable buffs/debuffs by source intent, side and removal flags; do not use one blanket clear-all operation.
Native status stealing where source/destination and transferable states match; unsupported states require review.
Preserve instant-death chance or delayed Doom where available, including fallback damage branches. Respect boss immunity; no guaranteed-death upgrade.
Native Reflect with decoded recipients, duration and reflected-action limits.

Mirrorcraft: a smaller magic-damage bonus if reflected-damage filtering cannot be validated. This passive modifies existing reflection in FFBE; it must not grant Reflect by itself. Self-chaining is not reproduced.
Native draw-attacks/taunt or camouflage. Bind self-benefits to the equipping party member and preserve attack-type restrictions where possible.
Cover/Multi-Cover/Royal Guard candidates. Verify physical/magic filters and recipients first; fallback is appropriately typed party mitigation, not universal cover.
Chance evasion is native; test whether Decoy can preserve Mirage's finite-hit guarantee. Otherwise use a weaker timed evasion buff and label the approximation.
Accuracy/evasion changes with correct attack type and sign. Never turn reduced enemy evasion into increased allied evasion without a replacement label.
Convert the referenced response skill too. Preserve trigger/chance/type/target, cap activation frequency and prevent counter loops.
Separate battle-start, revival, turn-start and delayed triggers; import child skills with cycle checks. Automatic item usage must retain its item cost or be replaced explicitly.
Preserve supported HP/ally conditions. Unsupported named-unit conditions become a smaller unconditional bonus only with explicit replacement approval.
Native survival at 1 HP, retaining threshold and activation limit. An unlimited Reprieve row is not an acceptable substitute for one-use guts.
Resonance/LB gauge fill, fill-rate and entrust are separate operations. Use native gauge units and caps, never FFBE crystal counts verbatim.
Primal Focus: a modest resonance-gauge charge; no separate FFBE evocation resource is added.
Evoke attacks become magic damage under the existing damage budget. Keep any death branch separate; do not add a free summon or morale multiplier.
Primal Attunement: a small MAG/SPR or resonance-damage benefit. Free esper selection itself is metadata, not a new FFR summon entitlement.
Preserve LB/specific-skill/attribute scope with FFR multipliers. Remap referenced IDs; discard neither the scope nor an activation requirement.
Native consecutive-use ramp when reset rules match; otherwise a fixed representative power tier with disclosed lost ramping.
Chaincraft: modest stagger-power or critical bonus. A chain cap must not become a huge always-on damage multiplier.
Preserve the decoded physical/magic damage, element, targets and hit frames. Replace only the automatic tag-chain behavior with a modest stagger bonus within the same total attack budget.

Retain active 159's physical damage as a separate component. FFBE break-bar damage and damage while broken can map to FFR stagger-related bonuses after confirming trigger meaning. Equipment conditions remain explicit.
Skyfall: a normal attack with jump motion and normalized power; retain invulnerability/delay only if the native action lifecycle is proven. Jump passives affect only converted jump skills.
Aegis: short physical and magical mitigation instead of claiming a true absorb-HP shield. Preserve the defensive role; cap broad mitigation.
Probe a reduced-healing multiplier and recipient direction. If unsupported, use a disclosed weakening debuff rather than reversed healing.
Quickcast: Haste by default. Test repeat/extra-action behavior separately; never repeat every child action without paying costs or ignore selection restrictions.
Keep a bounded weighted set of supported child actions. Unknown branches remain review items instead of silently changing random behavior to the strongest result.

Resolve unlock/cooldown/limited-use/upgrade/normal-attack wrappers into a skill graph, not an effect ID. Preserve availability and costs; where impossible, propose a balanced standalone signature move for review.
Focused Rhythm: temporary MP-cost relief for converted skills, not free restoration of limited-use charges. Keep this replacement visible.
Adjust eligible effect durations only; verify decrement support, unremovable states and owner/action timing.
Sunder Armor for physical weapons or Arcane Fracture for magical weapons: modest DEF/SPR reduction. Use one shared debuff when multiple weapon types are present.

Translate actual field mechanics to timed party/enemy effects with category/side restrictions where supported. Orange/element field colour remains visual only. Do not mistake the overlay for a gameplay field.
Fighting Spirit: gauge support or a bounded stat buff for morale gain; morale damage uses a fixed balanced power tier. Focus/Vertex chains need explicit unlock handling, not free max morale.

Use modest gauge/MP recovery, Aegis, capped follow-up damage or Focused Rhythm only while the approved BOOST substitute is active. Never grant permanent full-gauge/full-MP refill or percent-HP pursuit.
Weapon Mastery: a small role-appropriate stat/resistance bonus. Preserve equipment conditions only where FFR supports them; no illegal extra equipment slots or unbounded doublehand stats.
Leader's Resolve: a modest party buff if owner/category conditions can be enforced, otherwise a smaller self bonus. Never grant full FFBE leader percentages to everyone.
Native normal-attack-only repeat candidate. Confirm trigger/cost and hit-count limits; do not repeat the entire resonance.
Native Berserk with its control restriction. If only the offensive bonus is retained, label the changed drawback.
Heal after defending when the native trigger is validated; otherwise smaller timed regeneration with a replacement label.
Field Medic or Inspiring Voice: a small healing or support bonus; retain item/song scope if a native filter is proven.
Trailkeeper: small recovery or poison protection, with exploration timing retained if supported. No per-frame recovery in battle.
Native item/gil stealing with FFR loot rules; no duplicated rewards or invented items.
Bounded native gil/EXP/item-rate bonuses; economy caps are independent of combat damage normalization.
Native escape/encounter behavior only when source meaning matches. Preserve cannot-escape battles and confirm overworld ownership.
Decode hide/seal/remove/return/summon/skip/select-target behavior individually. Boss lifecycle effects and spawn references must not be auto-assigned to playable visions.
Preserve self-HP loss as a cost/penalty with its lethal/nonlethal rule; never treat it as outgoing damage.
Inspect as presentation metadata; it must not generate damage, buffs or permanent field colour by itself.
